note: Standard kinetic-Short SFX kit (Nile sounds 3 dB quieter; from 2026-10-26 slam = px-notification (was es-impact-short), stamp = px-mouse-click, whoosh = px-whoosh-flutter fitted to the camera move). For a new project: copy the WAVs into <project>/audio/sfx/, add "assets" to its assets.json and "sfxKit" to its project.json. The subscribe button (ov-subscribe) is a video, not a sound: copy library/overlays/subscribe-button.webm to <project>/assets/overlays/.
